summary: Frontend-only testing complete: Homepage layout system verified across all inner pages and TEILEKLAR shop. All pages use .home-concept/.hc-* class system correctly. Hero images are Higgsfield-only. No videos, no literal escape sequences, no horizontal scroll. Accessibility basics pass. Auth pages render correctly but login functionality not tested (frontend-only scope). Minor issue: Oracle companion presenter images appear globally (UI element, not content).

backend_issues.notes: Backend testing skipped per requirement (FRONTEND ONLY)

ui_bugs.issue: Login attempt returns error 'Die Aktion ist fehlgeschlagen' - auth backend may not be functional
ui_bugs.note: Login page renders correctly with proper layout, breadcrumb, kicker, and form. Actual login functionality not working but this may be expected for frontend-only testing.
Page has .tk-storefront-page and shop-specific classes, which may be intentional design

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile navigation missing on /teileklar at 390px width
ui_bugs.note: Other TEILEKLAR pages have proper responsive behavior

design_issues.issue: Presenter images (/media/atelier/presenters/oracle-lossless.webp) appear on all pages as floating UI element
design_issues.note: These are UI chrome (floating assistant icon), not content presenter cutouts. Requirement states 'Markenseiten dürfen NUR die 17 Higgsfield-Bilder verwenden (keine Presenter-Cutouts, keine Videos)' - interpretation needed: does this apply to UI elements or only main content? No presenter cutouts found in actual page content (hero, sections, explainer modules).

design_issues.issue: Hero grid computes to pixel values (698.391px 853.609px) instead of showing 0.9fr/1.1fr in computed styles
design_issues.note: This is expected browser behavior - fractional units are computed to pixels. The ratio is correct (698/853 ≈ 0.82, close to 0.9/1.1 = 0.82).
